# Build References

These generated IL2CPP assemblies let GitHub Actions compile the plugin without a local game installation:

- `unity-6000.3.6/Il2Cppmscorlib.dll`
- `unity-6000.3.6/UnityEngine.CoreModule.dll`

They are compile-only references for the game's validated Unity and BepInEx combination.

Update this reference together with the Unity version and BepInEx version when the target game changes.
